verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents built-in AI features embedded directly in the product — AI-powered trend detection across replays/heatmaps and AI-generated replay summaries — which is genuine in-product AI assistance rather than an external agent. However, this falls short of a general-purpose 'assistant' a user can delegate arbitrary tasks to (e.g., building reports, running analyses via natural-language commands); the closest to that (natural-language querying and dashboard creation) is delivered via the external MCP server for third-party AI assistants, not a built-in in-app assistant. Missing for 10: a documented in-app conversational/agentic assistant UI, evidence of broad task delegation (beyond trend-spotting and summarization), and independent hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as described.
